bartlett_limits.description: 95 % limits for lags 1 to `max_lag` by Bartlett's formula.

levels.description: 1 %, 5 % and 10 %, in that order (MacKinnon 2010 response surfaces).

lags.description: Exactly this many lagged differences, no search. Not with `max_lags`.

max_lags.description:
The largest number of lagged differences the AIC search considers;
absent or `null`: Schwert's rule. Not with `lags`.

model.description: Deterministic terms in the test regression.

AdfLevelDto.description: One significance level of the ADF test.

rejected.description: `statistic <= critical_value`: the unit root is rejected at this level.

max_lag.description:
Largest lag; absent = `min(⌊10·log₁₀ n⌋, n − 1)` for `acf`, and below
`n / 2` as well for `pacf` (statsmodels' defaults and limit).

BoolStats.description: Summary statistics for a boolean column.

CatStats.description: Summary statistics for a categorical column.

n.description: n — dimension of the square matrix.

labels.description: Cluster label per point: null = noise, number = cluster id.

bins.description: Explicit bin count (>= 1). When set, takes precedence over `bin_method`.

compute_ecdf.description: Whether to compute ECDF. Default: true.

compute_histogram.description: Whether to compute histogram. Default: true.

compute_qq_plot.description: Whether to compute QQ-plot. Default: true.

fit_distributions.description: Whether to fit distributions. Default: false.

significance_level.description: Significance level for normality tests. Default: 0.05.

n_bins.description: Number of bins for mutual information. None = auto (Sturges' rule).

target.description: Target values (continuous for permutation, categorical class ids for ANOVA/MI).

distance_threshold.description: Distance threshold for dendrogram cut (mutually exclusive with n_clusters).

max_points.description:
Max input points (memory guard). Omit for the default; `0` disables it.
Rejects oversized inputs before allocating the O(n²) distance matrix.

n_clusters.description: Number of flat clusters (mutually exclusive with distance_threshold).

max_samples.description: Subsample size per tree. 0 = auto (min(256, n)). Default: 0.

levels.description: 1 %, 2.5 %, 5 % and 10 %, in that order (Kwiatkowski et al. 1992, Table 1).

p_value.description: Interpolated in the table of critical values, clamped to [0.01, 0.10].

p_value_bound.description:
`"interpolated"`, or `"at_most"` / `"at_least"` when the statistic is
beyond the table and `p_value` is its bound.

lag_rule.description: How the long-run variance's truncation lag is chosen. Not with `lags`.

lags.description: Exactly this truncation lag, 0 to n − 1. Not with `lag_rule`.

model.description: What the null says the series is stationary around.

KpssLevelDto.description: One significance level of the KPSS test.

rejected.description: `statistic > critical_value`: stationarity is rejected at this level.

contamination.description:
Expected outlier fraction, in `[0, 1]`: the `ceil(n·contamination)`
highest scores are outliers and `threshold` in the result is the lowest
of them. Cannot be given with `threshold`.

threshold.description:
LOF score above which a point is an outlier. Default: 1.5 when
`contamination` is not given; cannot be given with it.

MergeDto.description: A single merge step in the dendrogram.

omitted.description:
The tests above that are absent, each with its reason; empty when all
four ran. `is_normal` combines only the tests that ran.

NumericStats.description:
Descriptive statistics for a single numeric column. A statistic the data
does not define is `undefined`: every one with no valid values; `std_dev`
and `variance` below 2 values; `skewness` below 3 and `kurtosis` below 4,
and both when the values do not vary.

OmittedTestDto.description:
A normality test with no result, and why. `min` is set for
`"too_few_values"`, `max` for `"too_many_values"`.

OutlierInputDto.description:
Univariate outlier detection on a flat numeric vector.

# Input
```json
{ "data": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 100.0], "method": "iqr" }
```
`method` ∈ `{"iqr"|"tukey", "zscore"|"three_sigma", "modified_zscore"|"hampel"}`.
Optional, defaults to `"iqr"`.

# Output
`{ method, indices, scores, count, pct, lower_fence, upper_fence, center, spread }`

`method` aliases: `tukey` → IQR Tukey fences (k=1.5), `three_sigma` →
mean ± 3·σ. `modified_zscore` fences at median ± 3.5·(MAD/0.6745)
(Iglewicz & Hoaglin), `hampel` at median ± 3·(MAD/0.6745) (the Hampel
identifier).

auto_scale.description:
Standardise each column to unit variance before the decomposition
(correlation-matrix PCA). Default: `true` — without it a column in
large units takes the leading components. `false` gives
covariance-matrix PCA.

n_components.description: Number of principal components to keep.

fitted.description: Fitted values, one per observation in input order.

residuals.description: Residuals `y − ŷ`, one per observation in input order.

near_edge.description:
Within kappa = 5 places of an end of the batch, where the
transform's own boundary handling moves the saliency most.

weights.description:
Robustness weight of each point in the last pass, in `[0, 1]` (all 1
without the outer loop); near 0 marks an outlier.

StlInputDto.description:
Input for `stl`. Every option but `period` is optional; absent or `null`
takes statsmodels' default.

inner_iterations.description: Passes of the inner loop, at least 1 (default 5, or 2 when robust).

low_pass.description:
Span of the low-pass smoother: odd, above the period (default the
smallest odd integer above it).

low_pass_degree.description: Degree of the low-pass Loess, 0 or 1 (default 1).

outer_iterations.description: Passes of the outer loop, at least 0 (default 0, or 15 when robust).

period.description:
Length of the seasonal cycle, at least 2; at least two full cycles of
data.

robust.description: Down-weight outliers with the outer loop (default false).

seasonal.description: Span of the seasonal smoother: odd, at least 3 (default 7).

seasonal_degree.description: Degree of the seasonal Loess, 0 or 1 (default 1).

trend.description:
Span of the trend smoother: odd, above the period (default the smallest
odd integer at least `1.5 · period / (1 − 1.5 / seasonal)`).

trend_degree.description: Degree of the trend Loess, 0 or 1 (default 1).

TextStats.description: Summary statistics for a text column.
